issue: Multi-resource mentions cleared the singular host binding without persisting a trusted target set. Follow-up references to these two directories became unresolved navigation scopes, and re-mentioning the nodes still caused per-resource selection prompts.
changes: Persist the exact explicitly referenced resource IDs as a target scope when more than one resource is selected.

Revalidate that resource selection against the current project inventory on subsequent turns; do not expand it to remembered resources or new project members, and require clarification if a selected member disappears.
Interpret relative directory references against an already confirmed scope while retaining the existing unknown/ambiguous project-folder safeguards.
Recognize concrete unique IPs in actual submitted human question answers and apply the recovered scope before subsequent tools in the same batch.
Preserve ordinary file, command, terminal, host-trust and resource-boundary permissions.
regressions: Three selected local fixture resources each perform actual directory reads across four HTTP turns: initial multi-mention, image-like directory follow-up text, a continuation, and repeated multi-mention. No target-selection prompt is generated.
Selection survives model-history compaction and engine state reload; a further follow-up reads all three nodes.
A remembered but unselected fourth resource cannot execute a directory read.
Revoking silentReadFiles still requires file_read authorization and does not ask to select the already selected target again.

Submitted IP choices recover an unresolved scope and permit the already queued same-batch read. Unsubmitted defaults, vague permission statements, negated addresses and duplicate resource names do not authorize a guessed target.
Deleted, missing or foreign selection members fail closed rather than silently shrinking or widening the target set. Existing directory and unqualified multi-host regressions remain covered.

checks.devRestart: passed after idle check; eight existing session snapshots healthy
